clinicalPearls: Sugammadex reverses rocuronium even from deep blockade
Dantrolene is the specific antidote for malignant hyperthermia

Train of four ratio above 0.9 before extubation
reference.pathophysiology: Depolarising blockade holds the endplate open until sodium channels inactivate, while competitive blockers occupy receptors without activation and fade as transmitter outcompetes them. Malignant hyperthermia instead is a muscle calcium channelopathy where triggers open ryanodine receptors uncontrollably, driving contracture, heat and acidosis until dantrolene closes them.
